thread:
alex: quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today

What I did: merged traffic-split PR for gw routing and validated test traffic in staging.
Blocker: noticing 429 spikes on the canary after merge, unclear if it's rate-limit config or an auth retry loop.
Today: triage 429s, coordinate rollback if needed, finalize rollout notes.

marina: I saw the 429s too. digging through gateway logs — auth-service is returning a burst of 503s which seems to trigger retries then 429s from the rate limiter. putting logs in the thread.

sam: pushed a small hotfix to stop retries on 503 at the gateway level (canary). also added a limited backoff. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/gw/commit/abcd1234
Can we temporarily lower the burst for canary to reduce token exhaustion? @rachel fyi for quota changes.

rachel: I can reduce the burst for canary to 100 and lower the sustained window if you want. doing that now. also recommend adding a route-level circuit-breaker so the gateway fails fast on auth 5xx.

alex: thanks. sam — can you paste the patch here for a quick eyeball? want to make sure it doesn't disable desired retries for other 5xx types.

sam: sure — snippet below:
```yaml
retry:
  on: [5xx]
  attempts: 0
```
Alternative (safer):
```yaml
retry:
  on: [auth-503]
  attempts: 0
```
Not 100% on matching rule name; this is the gist.

marina: ops note — auth logs show a DB failover at 03:12 UTC which caused the auth 503 spike. infra is following up. seems external to gateway but gateway retries amplified the effect.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: gw@canary v1.3.4 -> v1.3.5 (sam) :rocket:

alex: OK monitoring for 15m post-deploy. if 429 rate drops we'll continue with staged rollout. if not, rollback to v1.3.4 and escalate. I'll post rollout decision here.

jamie: small ask — can someone review my CR for the routing policy docs (PR #1234)? needs a second reviewer before EOD.

rachel: @jamie I'll take a look in ~30m.

marina: blocker for me — need longer retention on canary logs to triage. filing an infra ticket against eng-infra and will link it here.

sam: noted. also tweaked the alerting so it only fires if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m to reduce noise during noisy rollouts.

alex: great. today I'll: finalize rollback playbook and post it to #incidents, coordinate with ops for auth follow-up, and sign off on the routing policy docs after review. ping if anything urgent. :thumbsup:

(threads/attachments: logs, small config snippets, and the deploy link above)
